evidence_items.explanation: The surrounding remarks describe summarization, interactive research, travel planning, drafting and translation. This supports the breadth-of-capabilities component, but supplies neither a Tay benchmark nor a measurement of deception.

receipt.public_excerpt: ChatGPT writes believable scientific abstracts, though with completely generated data.

evidence_items.explanation: The experiment demonstrates that early ChatGPT could produce believable fabricated research. It predates the target period and does not measure Tay or Bing.
This establishes a relevant baseline: imitation was already part of Tay's design. It does not establish how successfully Tay fooled people, so its ability cannot fairly be assumed to have been zero.

unresolved_gaps: No comparable Tay-versus-February-2023 evaluation of human deception was located.
The records establish broad newer capabilities and believable ChatGPT output, but not the magnitude of both claimed improvements.
